title: Brief
description: The user's request as the skill understood it: the prompt verbatim, the use case, the frame, the tempo, the subject, narration and music choices, and the limits the user acknowledged. The first document of a job; the treatment is derived from it.

version.description: Version of this document kind; always 1.

id.description: Slug that names the brief, 2 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example "obsidian-bottle". Later documents refer to it as briefId.

title.description: Working title of the piece, for example "Obsidian bottle reveal".

prompt.description: The user's words verbatim, unedited, for example "a 10 second product reveal of a black glass bottle".

goal.description: What the piece must achieve in one sentence, for example "make the bottle feel premium".

audience.description: Who watches it, for example "shoppers on a product page".

durationSeconds.description: Target length in seconds, greater than 0, for example 10.

width.description: Frame width in pixels, even, matching aspect, for example 1920.

height.description: Frame height in pixels, even, matching aspect, for example 1080.

emotion.description: The feeling the piece should leave, for example "quiet confidence".

genre.description: Genre reference when the user gave one, for example "luxury advertising"; null when none.

era.description: Period reference when the user gave one, for example "1970s"; null when none.

paletteHints.description: Colour words from the prompt, in the order they appeared; empty when none.

items.description: One colour hint, for example "deep black" or "#0b0b0f".

mustHaveText.description: Text the piece must show verbatim, in order; empty when none.

items.description: One required line of text, for example "Now in 500 ml".

description.description: The subject in plain words, for example "a matte black glass bottle with a silver cap".

assetIds.description: Ids of ledger assets the subject uses (models, HDRIs), each present in assets.json under the data directory; empty when none.

items.description: One asset id as the ledger records it, for example "hdri:studio_small_09".

narration.description: Whether the piece is narrated and by which voice.

enabled.description: True when narration is produced (the narration component must be installed, ADR 0007).

script.description: The narration text when the user supplied it, for example "Meet the new bottle."; null when the treatment writes it or narration is off.

path.description: Absolute path of the user's music file (WAV, FLAC, MP3 or AAC) when policy is user-supplied, for example C:/music/bed.wav; null otherwise.

limitsAcknowledged.description: Limits the skill told the user about and the user accepted, in order; empty when none applied.

items.description: One acknowledged limit, for example "no photoreal humans".

createdAt.description: When the brief was written: an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with millisecond precision, for example 2026-10-26T20:00:00.000Z.

UseCase.description: What the piece is for; it selects the default lane, tempo and templates.

FrameRate.description: Frames per second of every shot and of the delivery.

Tempo.description: Cutting rhythm: calm (long shots), dynamic (medium), chaotic (very short) or single-shot (no cuts).

SubjectKind.description: What the piece shows: a product, an abstract form, a diagram, text, an environment or a mix.

Primitive.description: Procedural stand-in geometry for the subject when no asset is supplied; none means no stand-in.

Voice.description: Narration voice of the optional narration component (ADR 0007); the prefix is accent and gender.

MusicPolicy.description: Where music comes from: none, or a file the user supplies and licenses.
